decisions.why: ParaBeads, ParaBeads SF, Paraclick, Midi Parasep are parasitology laboratory consumables and testing reagents
Leishmania dipstick, H.pylori Ag, faecal occult blood, ImmuView S. Pneumoniae are point-of-care rapid diagnostic tests
DetectFOB (fecal occult blood test) is a laboratory consumable for clinical chemistry analysis
Cellulose acetate membranes are laboratory consumables for electrophoresis analysis
